title: Known-object test, TOI-2433.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-2433.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Residual screen: 50 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 22 distinct event(s), 4 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
